create.name: Louisa Tanner Munson
create.bio:
Louisa Tanner Munson is an astrologer and intuitive coach who works under the name Feel Good Astrology and is based in Portugal. She began studying astrology, meditation and ways of reshaping habits of mind in her twenties, and spent many years as a consultant to large companies on personal development and performance before turning to one-to-one work with private clients after the birth of her first child. She has lived in several countries and trained in a range of complementary approaches along the way.

Her readings look at a person's birth chart in relation to their character, the season of life they are in and the choices ahead, and longer sessions compare charts between partners or family members or look for good dates to marry, move or start a business. Readings are recorded so clients can listen back. Her style is warm, informal and practical, and she often weaves gentle hypnotic suggestion into her guided recordings. She hosts the Feel Good Astrology podcast, posts relaxation and reflection videos on YouTube, and has a handful of guided meditations on Insight Timer that are free to hear.

courses.title: Astrology Consultation Readings
courses.description: Recorded one-to-one astrology readings booked online. The 60-minute reading looks at your own chart, what is happening now and next, or a clear yes-or-no question; the 90-minute reading compares your chart with another person's or a business, or looks for good dates for big moves. She notes a waiting list of about four weeks.

free_resources.title: Louisa Tanner Munson on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: A small set of guided meditations from Louisa that mix relaxation with gentle hypnotic suggestion, including a love and protection practice. Free to listen in the app or on the web.

free_resources.title: Feel Good Astrology podcast
free_resources.description: Louisa's podcast on reading the planets for self-understanding and planning ahead, with occasional guided relaxation. Free to stream on Spotify.

flags: Her YouTube channel (linked as youtube_url) hosts guest conversations with health angles, e.g. a talk on the Spooky2 frequency device as a 'healing plan', iridology clips and a guest's process to 'rid yourself of ... trauma'. Her own site sells only astrology readings, so a plan was written, but a human should decide whether to keep the channel link or skip her.
Only one photo could be confirmed: her YouTube channel avatar (500 px, woman with headphones at a microphone). Her site's only other personal photo is a family group shot with children, not used.
Thin, low-activity profile: last Insight Timer upload about seven years ago; YouTube videos used have very low view counts (14-123).
Site shows two price sets: the live home page has €250/€350, an older /home2023/ page has €333 for 90 minutes; live home prices used.
Her husband Carl Munson co-hosts some of her shows; the podcast and YouTube also carry the older email louisa@feelgoodastrology.com, not used.
Insight Timer bio says she 'trained in many healing modalities' and runs a group called 'Explore healing through Astrology'; not used in the bio.
left_out: YouTube astrology forecasts (dated, e.g. May 2022) and live-show recordings titled 'Copy of ...'.
YouTube guest interviews and Spooky2 / iridology / trauma clips: not her teaching and health-angled.
Insight Timer tracks 'Preparing For Birth' and 'Love Your Body Better': not listed (profile link covers them; birth and body-image themes borderline).
